title: YouTube Autocomplete with FlashData
description: Enter your Key and required query input. Start performs one YouTube Autocomplete request using your FlashData Credits.

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Your own FlashData API key with YouTube Suggestions permission. Encrypted; no shared key is provided.

query.title: Query
query.description: A single search query or query prefix. No automatic query expansion.

language.title: Language
language.description: Requested language code. Does not translate content.

region.title: Region
region.description: Two-letter region code, such as US or GB.
